tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i las byang gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzha
༄༅/ /rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i las byang gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i las byang gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i las byang gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lha mchog stobs ldan 'jigs byed 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pas/ bsnyen pa thems pa'i sngags pas phrin las gzhung bsrang ba'i tshe lha tshogs rnams thugs dam bskang zhing las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i phyir tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ba ni/ thun mtshams su rang gi mdun du zhing ngam gcan gzan gyi lpags pa gcal ba'i steng du zan nam/ maṃ sa ma da na la sogs pa bza' bca' btung ba'i longs spyod sna tshogs pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi lhung bzed dam lcags snod du liṅga khrag gis sbags pa sha rus kyi dum bu dang bcas pa dang*/ gal 'gag thug pa yin na gzugs can la de'i ming rus dang dri ma/ gzugs med la de'i ming dang gnas pa'i sa shing chu rdo la sogs pas gzugs la sbags shing*| le'u brgyad pa dang bco lnga par gsungs pa'i gnas yig rnams bris pa dug khrag gis sbags te gnas so sor btab/ phung re'am ro ras nag po'i gdan dang khebs bya/ gdab phur thun rdzas mi bsad pa'i mtshon/ dur rdo'i gtun gru gsum gri rgod kyi a tho/ gri rkang gi gzar bu la sogs 'du byas/ rang nyid stobs ldan nag po'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ tshogs rdzas rnams me chu rlung gis sbyangs shing*| hūm̐ */ bdag nyid stobs ldan thugs srog las: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chu: spros pas tshogs kyi 'bag btsog dang : dngos 'dzin nyes pa'i dri ma rnams: bsregs gtor bkrus nas dag par byas: raṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ: yaṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa yaṃ: khaṃ badz+ra sna ta khaṃ: bdud rtsis bran la: hūm̐ */ rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu'i steng: a las tshogs gzhong bhan+dha 'bar: de'i nang dri chu bzhi mnyam dang : rak+ta khu ba klad pa lngar: oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ swā hās mtshan: de'i steng dbus su mi yi sha: mtshams bzhir ba lang khyi glang rta:

so sor māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ: gyis mtshan rlung g.yos me sbar khol: rdzas zhu de'i steng hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ: mthing dmar dkar ba brtsegs pa las: 'od 'phros rgyal mchod snod bcud kyi: bdud rtsi bkug nas de la bstim: de nyid 'od zhu bcud dang 'dres: bdud rtsi'i rgya tsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang*/ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs nas 'thor phud bcad/ slar gtor mar sgron cing tshogs chang dang sman raka kyang bran la: hūm̐ */ chos dbyings mkha' khyab e yi zhing khams nas: lha mchog stobs ldan nag po yab dang yum: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: las kyi bdag po gza' mchog rā hu la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: phrin las rab 'byams dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rgya dang bal po'i sa mtshams yul shed nas: 'chi bdag srog len nag po yab yum bcas: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mon yul ngam khrod 'bar ba'i phug shed nas: sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa rnam pa gsum: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bcol ba'i las kun 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'dzam gling srid pa'i las kyi zhing kun nas: sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon bco brgyad po: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs: sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sngags 'chang las grub dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e nṛ tri mu tri tri tri ya ma ma ma ru lu de wa tirta ka du phrag dun+tiṃ:

rak+sha rak+mo rak+sha yak+sha ya yak+mo rā tsa mun mun shū la badz+ra sā dhu haṃ shaṃ ru tri sa nā ga sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: zhes 'bul/ bar pas bskang zhing bshags pa ni: sha zan tshogs rdzas sman raka bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ nam mkha'i khams rnams yongs gang ba'i: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: bza' bca' btung ba gzugs sgra dri: ro dang reg bya chos kyi dbyings: dgyes dgu'i longs spyod mtha' yas pa: dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa dang : dgra bo'i srog dbugs bla dang tshe: phung khams skye mched mi nor rdzas: ma lus dregs pa'i tshogs la 'bul: stobs ldan yab yum thugs dam bskang : rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : srog len yab yum thugs dam bskang : mon pa rnam gsum thugs dam bskang : 'chi bdag gshin rje'i thugs dam bskang : srog bdag ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : ma hā de wa'i thugs dam bskang : kā lā yak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : bdud me'i kha rlangs thugs dam bskang : bdud mo khrag 'dzag thugs dam bskang : srin po glog phreng thugs dam bskang : srin mo khrag mig thugs dam bskang : gza' bdud nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin gang bzang thugs dam bskang : sha za ral can thugs dam bskang : rgyal po le byin thugs dam bskang : dmu rje btsan pa'i thugs dam bskang : yam shud dmar po'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : khu le lag dgu'i thugs dam bskang : rkang lag ring po'i thugs dam bskang : gzhon nu gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : 'khor tshogs pho rgyud thugs dam bskang : 'khor tshogs mo rgyud thugs dam bskang : 'khor tshogs klu rgyud thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la phrin las sgrubs: zhes dang*/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ lha chen stobs ldan dpa' bo yab dang yum: khyab 'jug chen po srog len yab dang yum: tshe srog 'chi bdag mon pa rnam pa gsum: sngags bdag dregs pa'i ded dpon bco brgyad tshogs:

rang rang 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol: khyod rnams ye shes spyan ldan mthu rtsal bdag: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig bya ra mdzad: bdag cag ma rig rmongs shing 'khrul bas 'khor: sku yi phyag rgya ma gsal sngags ma dag: ting 'dzin g.yel zhing mchod gtor dus las 'gyangs: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'bod rbad bsad mnan sogs: drod tshad ma rtogs bab bcol 'chol bar spyad: dregs pa'i mthun rdzas gzir rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas: bskang rdzas sgrub rdzas rten pa'i rdzas la sogs: dgos pa'i yo byad ma 'dzom des chog dang : des yong dbang za tshod yod ras gcod nongs: kun kyang 'bag btsog rgyu chung phud nyams shing : lhag 'dres gsang sgo g.yel dang lhag par g.yel: sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig las 'das 'gal nyams ci mchis pa: gnong ngo 'gyod do dam can srung ma'i tshogs: gnong 'gyod sems kyis de ring mthol zhing bshags: mthol bshags bzod pa dang du bzhes nas kyang : sgrib bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub deng stsol cig: ces gong gi sngags mthar yig brgya btags pa tshar gang 'grub bzlas: tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: ling khebs bsal: gser skyems bshams la/ mkhyen par gsol zhing gzu dpang bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro g-ing laṅka: yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan dgu gzu dang dpang : lha mchog dregs bdag stobs ldan yab yum dang : ci bgyi'i pho nya gza' bdud rā hu la: srog len yab yum las mkhan mon pa gsum: sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad gzu dang dpang : lha srin sde brgyad pho mo klu rgyud kyis: bsdus pa'i dregs pa las la grub pa'i tshogs: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: g.yel med snang srid dregs pa gzu dang dpang : bdag ni zol med don gyi rnal 'byor pa: sems can don slad byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir:

'dul khrims byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa sogs: rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lam bzang nyams blangs nas: tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la: zhing bcu'i dgra dang bgegs kyis ma ster ro: sangs rgyas bstan bshig dam chos nyams par bgyis: dge 'dun sde smad dben ri gnyan po bcom: rgyu 'bras khyad bsad 'gro drug yongs la 'tshe: rdo rje slob dpon smad cing yi dam brnyas: dkon mchog gsum smad chos skyong khyad du gsod: bsnyen sgrub bar gcod mched lcam yongs la 'khu: dam tshig las ldog dam tshig can kun smod: sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs tshogs la: bdag gis dang por ma len sems ma nyes: bar du mi 'gyod kha yis ngan ma smras: tha mar ma len lag gis phod ma btsugs: ngan lan bzang bcal phan gdags drin bzos kyang : nyes byed dgra 'dis dus kun 'tshe ba na: rtsa gsum srung ma dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: gzu dang dpang mdzod legs nyes zhal lce chod: bden pa'i rgyab bzung nyes byed da lta sgrol: ma g.yel ma 'da' sgrub pa'i srung ma rnams: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes bsgrags/ rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni: liṅga rak+tas bran la: phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing nag chad pa mdun du 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ drag po chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gshin rje'i zhing khams/ dgra bgegs las ngan thams cad smin par byed pa'i btson khang nag po gru gsum/ dug lnga'i me chu sa shing lha srin sde brgyad kyi bshan pas yongs su gang ba'i nang nṛ las/ dgra'am tri las bgegs che ge mo'i phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rid la nyam thag pa nad dang sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba/ 'o dod 'bod cing skra 'bal brang rdung ba/ skyob pa'i srung mas spangs te gsod byed las kyi bshan pas yongs su bzung ba zhig tu gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/

khyab 'jug srog len yab yum/ mon pa rnam gsum/ sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad rnams kyi snying kha'i srog yig la phog pas skad cig la bskul te: de rnams kyi sprul pa'i pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa grangs med pa 'phros: dgra bgegs dmigs bya de dag gnas nas bkug cing : lcags kyus snying nas drangs: zhags pas ske nas bzung : lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams: dril bus rgyab nas phul te skad cig la khrid: sha trūṃ pra we sha ya phaṭa: ces pas nya bo bskyed pas khog pa kha phye: ā we sha ya phaṭa: ces pas bkug pa'i bla srog rnam shes de nyid liṅga'i snying nang du nṛ tri gnas pa la thim/ rū pa sha ya phaṭa: ces pas khog pa kha bsums te gson po'i snang ba ci 'dra ba de kho na nyid du gyur ces dmigs: do gal dang bstun pa'i bden stobs brgya phrag gam/ nyer gcig gam/ dgu/ bdun/ lnga/ gsum la sogs pa ci rigs brjod/ pho nyas dgug pa ni: hūm̐ */ nga ni dregs bdag stobs ldan dpal: khros pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: khyab 'jug srog len mon pa dang : sngags bdag dregs pa gnad nas bskul: 'khor tshogs snang srid sde brgyad bcas: nam mkha'i skar ltar pho nya'i tshogs: lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs rnams kyis: snying nas drongs la myur du khug: zhags pa 'bar ba thogs rnams kyis: ske nas khrid la myur du khug: lcags sgrog 'bar ba thogs rnams kyis: yan lag sdoms la myur du khug: dril bu 'bar ba thogs rnams kyis: rgyab nas phul la myur du khug: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di: da lta nyid du gnas 'dir khug: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: de'i tshe bla srog 'khyams pa na: 'gugs byed pho nya khyod rnams kyis: 'jab cing rgyug cing 'ded pa dang : 'dzing zhing gsod pa'i las gyis la:

ma shor ba ru khug la shog: ma gtong myur du khrid la shog: bla srog rnam shes gzugs la phob: dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du gyis: rten la phob cig aṅku dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pho nya drag tu btang la bkug: slar sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug pa ni: lag pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ting 'dzin gong bzhin par/ sngags ni: hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ: bhig naṃ e sa ma ya che ge mo'i srog la thuṃ ril bh+yo bh+yo ya: che ge mo sha trūṃ srog nṛ hur thuṃ dza dzaḥ ā kar+ṣa ya nṛ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gal che chung dang bstun la grangs mang nyung ci rigs bzla'o: de nas lha dang phral ba ni: hūm̐ */ stobs ldan 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku: 'khor tshogs sngags bdag dregs par bcas: thugs dam bskul la sa ma ya: dam nyams las ngan dgra bo 'di: kha sbyor dbye ba'i dus la bab: skyob byed srung ma'i tshogs dang phrol: gsod byed bshan pa'i lag tu sprod: dgra lha dang phyes dgra 'drer sprod: pho lha dang phyes pho 'drer sprod: yul lha dang phyes yul 'drer sprod: srog lha dang phyes srog bdud sprod: zhang lha dang phyes zhang 'drer sprod: ma lha dang phyes mo 'drer sprod: ban bon lha phyes bdud dang sprod: bang lha dang phyes bang 'drer sprod: dam nyams las ngan dgra 'di la: skyob par byed pa'i lha srung rnams: dam nyams sdig can 'di spongs la: rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis: gal te mi nyan 'di bsrung na: dgra dang srung ma lhan cig tu: da lta nyid du sgrol bar gyis: de bas rang srog rang srungs la: byer zhig dengs shig bhi taṃ sha: ci ste stobs ldan bka' las ni: khyod rnams 'da' na bka' chad kyis: khyod kyi lus sems rdul phran ltar: brlags nas rdo rje'i dmyal ba ru: me chu tsha grang sdug bsngal rgyu: de bas da lta 'gro bar gyis: zhes dang : de wa a traka rak+ṣa ya: sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: dkrug phye phye:

de wa a praka sha phye phye: a nā ga du ne yu ka la ti pa tsa ya: she ma ma du me: dz+nyā raka du ne: na rak+mo du ni: sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bhi taṃ sha ya che ge mo sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: pra shaka phye phye ya ya: che ge mo'i de wa uts+tsha ta ya phaṭa phaṭa: ci nus bzla: do gal che na rdzas bdug ka u'i 'dab ma sogs gzhung ltar dbye ba'i las bya'o/ de nas thun brab pa ni/ gzhung ltar tshogs pa'i thun rdzas sngags kyis ngar btags pa'i thun snod lag g.yon pas bzung : g.yas pas brab cing bskul ba ni: hūm̐ */ nga ni stobs ldan 'jigs byed rgyal: stong gsum dbang byed khyab 'jug ni: dregs bdag nga yi bya ma rta: srog len pho mo mon pa gsum: sngags bdag bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas: drag po thun gyi dmag dpung gis: dam nyams sdig can rlog par byed: nyes byed dgra bo las ngan 'di'i: bla tshe srog la thun zor ya: dbugs mdangs bcud la thun zor ya: rnam shes tshogs la thun zor ya: dbang po lnga la thun zor ya: phung po lnga la thun zor ya: 'byung ba lnga la thun zor ya: skye mched drug la thun zor ya: don snod rtsa la thun zor ya: sha khrag rus la thun zor ya: thun zor sngags bdag dregs pa'i dmag: mda' thun ral gri thog ser nad: sa chu me rlung lag tu thogs: 'ur 'ur chems chems dgra la ya: chil chil shar shar dgra la ya: dgra bgegs rtsad gcod drung nas phyung : thal ba rdul phran bzhin du rlogs: e sa ma ya dgra la bh+yo: garbaha nag po a mu kaṃ: dgra bo che ge mo sha trūṃ trig nan: rbad nan: bhi na tsit+ta rbad nan: srog nṛ hur thuṃ dza: mā ra ya rbad sod nan: khaṃ shag ro myag muk+ti rbad ya: dgra bo che ge mo'i srog rtsa dmar po la mā ra ya nṛ rbad: rtsa tig srog tig snying tig la phob ya: zhes gnam lcags ur mo'i bsad sngags bzla zhing thun brab phur bu gdab pa ni: gdab phur thal mo'i bar bcug ste: hūm̐ */ nga ni 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku:

dpal chen stobs ldan khro bo'i rgyal: dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad gdengs: zhabs brgyad dregs pa gzir zhing gnon: dang po'i phyag gnyis phur bu sgril: g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin ni: rgyal ba khrag 'thung yab lnga la: g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin can: khrag 'thung yum lnga'i rang bzhin te: yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las: sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: sku stod khro bo chen po la: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu 'bar: phyag gnyis rdo rje phur bu sgril: rdo rje'i lte bar kun tu bzang : yar gyi rwa lngar khrag 'thung lnga: mar gyi rwa lngar kro dhī lnga: rgya mdud gong la rtsa brgyud kyi: bla ma'i pho brang 'og ma ni: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gnas: dbal la dam can dregs pa'i tshogs: sprin ltar 'khrigs shing glog ltar 'khyug: gzas pa'i snying nang khrag thigs ni: thig le'i dbus su rlung dwangs ma: 'od lnga'i klong du rnam shes rten: a dkar tshe rten nṛ ljang gu: srog rten tri dmar dang bcas pa: ces phur bu sgril zhing nya bo'i snying khar bstim gyis dbal nub bar btab la/ phur bu sgril zhing 'debs pa'i tshe: khrag gi dwangs ma 'ubs kyis skam: rlung gi dwangs ma yud kyis gtor: rnam shes tshe srog rten a nṛ: tri rnams phur bu'i rtse mo nas: khong gseng lam brgyud tshe srog rten: phur bu'i steng nas bdag la bstim: rnam shes ngo bo a dkar po: phur bu'i nang brgyud kun bzang gi: thugs kar thim pas mngon sangs rgyas: phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: zhes phur bu bton la: slar sgril zhing gnas rnams su gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ rdo rje phur bu'i dbal rtse nas: nad mtshon thog ser char phab pas: gzas pa gtan nas rlog par gyis: dran byed sems la kī la ya: mthong byed mig la kī la ya: thos byed rna bar kī la ya: snom byed sna la kī la ya: smra byed lce la kī la ya: 'du byed lus la kī la ya: las byed lag la kī la ya:

'gro byed rkang la kī la ya: me khams snying la kī la ya: chu khams mkhal mar kī la ya: lcags khams glo bar kī la ya: shing khams mchin par kī la ya: sa khams mtsher par kī la ya: bla dbugs srog la kī la ya: tshe bsod 'byor par kī la ya: srog dang lus la kī la ya: dbang thang rlung ltar kī la ya: gong gi pha la kī la ya: 'og gi ma la kī la ya: rgan pa khu bor kī la ya: gzhon pa nu bor kī la ya: srid kyi chung mar kī la ya: mchan gyi bu la kī la ya: chung rgyud bu mor kī la ya: 'og rta 'gel mdzor kī la ya: nor rdzas zhing la kī la ya: yul mkhar khyim la kī la ya: zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e tri mu tri tri tri: ya ma a tha du du ra ra ra k+ṣa k+ṣa tsa pa tsa tri tri tri phu sa ma ya dgra bo a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ trig nan rbad nan: bhi na tsit+ta rbad nan: badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa: ces btab/ mi bsad kyi mtshon chas rdeg cing: hūm̐ */ sgrol byed stobs ldan he ru kaḥ khyab 'jug srog len mon pa gsum: sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad tshogs: bshan pa lha srin sde brgyad bcas: rno mtshon glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis: dgra bo lnga phung rtsad nas chod: bsgral ba las kyis gdug pa 'dul: gti mug chos dbyings ngang du bsgral: zhe sdang me long ngang du bsgral: nga rgyal mnyam nyid ngang du bsgral: 'dod chags sor rtog ngang du bsgral: phrag dog bya grub ngang du bsgral: phung lnga khrag 'thung yab lngar bsgral: 'byung lnga khrag 'thung yum lngar bsgral: skye mched sems dpa' sems mar bsgral: nyon mongs khro bo bcu ru bsgral: tshigs rtsa khro mo bcu ru bsgral: rlung bcu pha rol phyin bcur bsgral: rnam shes kun bzang dgongs klong bsgral: dgra bgegs 'khor ba'i skye rgyud chod: las ngan rnam smin zhi bar mdzod: ces dum bur bsgral lo: bstab pa ni/ ling ror sman raka bran lag tu thogs la:

hūm̐ */ bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: dam nyams bsgral ba'i dbugs bla srog: sha khrag rus pags don snod bcas: khrag 'thung stobs ldan zhal du bstab: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo'i zhal du bstab: khyab 'jug chen po'i zhal du bstab: srog len yab yum zhal du bstab: mon pa rnam gsum zhal du bstab: 'chi bdag gshin rje la sogs pa: gshin rje yongs kyi zhal du bstab: skye 'gro srog gi bdag mo sogs: ma mo yongs kyi zhal du bstab: lha chen ma hā de wa sogs: lha rabs yongs kyi zhal du bstab: mu stegs kā lā yak+sha sogs: log 'dren yongs kyi zhal du bstab: bdud po me'i kha rlangs sogs: pho bdud yongs kyi zhal du bstab: bdud mo nag mo khrag 'dzag sogs: bdud mo yongs kyi zhal du bstab: srin po rak+sha glog phreng sogs: srin po yongs kyi zhal du bstab: srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig sogs: srin mo yongs kyi zhal du bstab: gza' bdud rā hu la sogs pa: gza' rnams yongs kyi zhal du bstab: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po sogs: gnod sbyin yongs kyi zhal du bstab: sha za ral pa can la sogs: gnod sbyin mo kun zhal du bstab: rgyal po le byin ha ra sogs: rgyal po yongs kyi zhal du bstab: dmu rje btsan pa chen po sogs: dmu rnams yongs kyi zhal du bstab: btsan rgod yam shud dmar po sogs: btsan rnams yongs kyi zhal du bstab: dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa sogs: ma sangs yongs kyi zhal du bstab: 'gong po khu le lag dgu sogs: 'gong po yongs kyi zhal du bstab: dam sri rkang lag ring po sogs: dam sri yongs kyi zhal du bstab: klu rgyal gzhon nu gtum po sogs: klu rnams yongs kyi zhal du bstab: bka' 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag: phyi nang gsang sbas bstan skyong dang : drag sngags btags chags ma chags dang : las byed bstan srung myur mgyogs kyi: sde brgyad pho mo klu rgyud kyis: bsdus pa'i tshogs kun ma lus pa:

sha rul dri la sbrang ma bzhin: dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: don snod dbang po rkang klad tshil: sman raka gtor ma'i dga' ston la: rings par mgyogs par la 'ur du: 'dus shig tshogs shig dregs pa'i tshogs: sha la dga' ba sha la zo: sha zan rkan sgra tog cing rol: khrag la dga' ba khrag la 'thung : khrag 'thung mid pa khyur gyis rol: rus la dga' ba rus pa mur: rus mur so sgra chems chems rol: pags par dga' ba pags pa gyon: pags gyon brjid lhub 'jigs par rol: don snod dga' ba don snod zo: cag cag lcib lcib dang bcas rol: klad par dga' ba klad pa ldog: klad ldag lce dmar yug gis rol: ljan ljin dga' ba ljan ljin zo: kha gdangs mche gtsigs rngams par rol: dgyes pa'i longs spyod sman rak+ta: gtor ma bza' bca' btung bar bcas: bstab pa bdag gis ma nor gyis: bzhes pa khyod kyis ma nor bzhes: gsol lo rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: zhes dang*/ mi rkang gi gzar bus gtor mar sgron cing sngags rnams ming rkyang ngam/ ming srog sbrags pa'am/ srog rkyang pa'i mthar/ ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ go ro tsa na/ keṃ ni ri ti/ tsit+ta srog ādz+nyā/ a mṛ ta/ rak+ta khā hi sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes bstabs shing bsngo'o// de nas tshogs nas bar lhag dum tsam zhig bcad la logs su bzhag: gzhan rnams kha na ma tho ba'i tha mal pa'i spyod pa dang mi ldan pas longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus pa dang*/ bar lhag dang*/ sngar bcad pa'i 'thor phud rnams snod so sor bshams: sman raka bran la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: lhag ma'i gtor ma dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po sman raka gtor tshogs kyi 'dod yon la sogs pa lha tshogs thams cad kyi dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i mchod tshogs ngo bo rang bzhin rmad du byung ba nam mkha'i khams gang ba zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod dam par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum dang*/ ha hoḥhrīḥ

lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ e ā ra li uts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs la spyan drangs/ hūm̐ */ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: dpal chen 'khor bcas phud kyi bdag: bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu: sngags 'chang longs spyod rol pa'i rgyan: tha mar lhag mas mi brngan rgyu: 'khor gyi las byed lhag la dbang : mchod nas las la mi bskul rgyu: zhing bcu dam nyams bsgral re ran: rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos kun gdod nas rang bzhin gcig: ces gsum po gcig tu dril: sman raka bran mar me bltams la: hūm̐ e ya: lha mchog stobs ldan 'khor bcas kyi: dkyil 'khor srung ba'i dam can dang : bran dang bka' sdod pho nya dang : g.yog dang yang g.yog bcas pa'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ging chen dang : laṅka sa bdag 'bar ma'i tshogs: spor ma pho nya mo dang sring : sha za smyo byed rjed byed gdon: 'byung po yi dwags dregs pa'i tshogs: snang zhing srid pa'i dregs pa rnams: stobs ldan dregs bdag dam bzhin du: bka' yi pho nya rtsal ma zhan: dgra bgegs brlag phyir bang ma bul: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma btul: bskul ba'i tshe na rgab ma lji: rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung : bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring : khur ba'i tshe na phrag ma lji: gsol ba'i tshe na 'khu ma ldog: lhag ma'i longs spyod 'di dag ni: snoms shig bzhes shig rol par gyis: dgyes shing tshims nas bcol ba'i las: ma thogs myur du 'grub par mdzod: brngan pa'i mchod pa mi bzhes shing : bcol ba'i phrin las mi bsgrub na: dregs bdag khrag 'thung bka' 'das shing : dpal gyi lung la 'gal ba'i phyir: de yi chad pa mi bzad pas: khyod rnams nyams shing brlags nas kyang : rdo rje'i dmyal bar shi ka re: me chu tsha grang sdug bsngal 'byung : de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: rang las bcol ba myur sgrubs shig:

oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa pa ti sarba kā ma pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtsang sar ma 'thor bar spung gis phul: bshal chu btang ngo : de ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di'ang dregs pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe 'byor na'ang shin tu legs la: phan gnod kyi mdos la sogs pa'i tshe ni med na mi rung ba yin pas shes par bya zhing : 'khor lo liṅga sogs las sbyor gyi tshe rnams su'ang liṅga la dmigs nas gong gi gzu dpang nas gtun rdung gi bar byas nas drag po mngon spyod bsgral 'dren gyi las kyis sngags pa hom khung kha nas 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa dpyis phyin par 'gyur la: deng sang ngan thabs gyi na tsam gyis gzhan srog 'phrog pa ni khro phu lo tsā ba'i rnam thar du/ rdo rje'i dmyal bar a la la// zhes sogs lo rgyus rnams su gsungs pa nyams su myong bas nyen che bar gda' bas ya cha'o// smras pa/ log smra'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ngas// rim gnyis rdo rje'i go cha btsan gyon cing*// drag po sngags kyi bso sgras stong gsum gang*// dregs byed ma rungs dpung gi tshogs bsdus nas// phur thun mtshon cha'i 'phrul 'khor drag po yis// las ngan dgra bgegs mgo snying bkas nas kyang*// bsgral ba'i sha khrag srung mar dga' ston du// btang bas bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rming med par// byas 'di sngags pa nag po nga min su// de ltar rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i rgyud kyi las gzhung gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes me bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar po'i rgyal ba gsum pa la/ dbur stod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
